card.line: Capernaum was a city by the Sea of Galilee where Jesus made His home after leaving Nazareth, and where He taught and healed.

moments.title: Jesus makes His home here
moments.text: After leaving Nazareth, Jesus went to live in Capernaum by the sea. Matthew says this fulfilled Isaiah's words about a great light dawning for people in darkness.

moments.title: The centurion's great faith
moments.text: A centurion asked Jesus to heal his paralyzed servant and said Jesus only needed to say the word. Jesus marveled at his faith, and the servant was healed at that very hour.

moments.title: Teaching with authority
moments.text: On the Sabbath Jesus taught in the synagogue, and the people were astonished. He told an unclean spirit to come out of a man, and it obeyed.

moments.title: Who is the greatest?
moments.text: In a house in Capernaum, Jesus asked the disciples what they had argued about on the way. He taught that whoever wants to be first must be the servant of all, and He held a little child in His arms.

moments.title: The bread of life teaching
moments.text: Jesus taught in the synagogue about the bread that came down from heaven. Many disciples turned back, but Peter said Jesus has the words of eternal life.
